# Дизайн Атлас (Design Atlas)

> Анти ИИ-слоп: готовые визуальные системы без «сгенерируй красиво». Сборка — снаружи.

Product: Дизайн Атлас
Marketing promise: Анти ИИ-слоп
Primary language (UI): Russian
Docs language: English

## Surfaces

- Home: / — brand + entry to Studio (primary) and Cards (secondary)
- Studio: /studio — Template × Style preview → Agent + Constructor prompts (RU+EN) → build elsewhere (Cursor / constructor agents)
- Cards: /cards — marketplace product-card visual styles → image-gen prompts (RU+EN) → generate elsewhere
- Demo landings: /demo and /demo/{styleId}
- Style QA playground: /playground and /playground/{styleId}
- App shell / design-system chrome: /design-system

## Content SSOT (Git)

- Web design systems: content/styles/{id}/
- Page templates: content/templates/{id}/
- Card styles: content/card-styles/{id}/

## Not this product

- Not a site constructor or page builder canvas
- Not an in-product image generator
- Not a design course / encyclopedia-first UX
